item.title: Nice interior! The Mamie Garndner House, Circa 1904 in North Carolina. $275,000
item.description: This house has a nice interior! I love the porch! I would turn the little outbuilding that has water, electric and a wall heater, into a guesthouse. The Mamie Garndner House was built in 1904. It is located on .4 acre in Murfreesboro, North Carolina. The house features a large wrap around front porch, original wood flooring, crown moulding, wide baseboards, pretty staircase, wainscoting, chair rails, updated bathrooms and built-ins. item.title: This has potential! On 7 1/2 acres in Virginia. $218,000
item.description: This house has a lot of potential! I love that it has two staircases and some acreage! Looks livable, so one could easily move in and work room by room. The house was built in 1830. It is located on 7.55 acres in Chase City, Virginia. The house could use some undoing of past renovations, but the areas that are original are nice. item.title: Pretty church with a pretty view! Circa 1934 in West Virginia.$149,900
item.description: This is a pretty church with an even prettier view! The church was built in 1934. It is located on .3 acre in Glen Falls, West Virginia. The church features wood floors, pretty ceiling, original pews, beautiful arched windows, crown moulding, baseboards and a spacious kitchen. The church is situated across from the Kanawha Falls section of the Kanawha River. There is potential for five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,316 square feet. $149,900 Contact Brian Mink with Bass Sinko Real Estate: 304-553

item.title: Original details! Could be so amazing! One acre in Wisconsin. $314,900
item.description: This house has so many original details! With some work, this could be really amazing. The house was built in 1873. It is located on one acre in Oshkosh, Wisconsin. The house features a spacious kitchen, wood floors, baseboards, pocket doors, crown moulding, two staircases, vintage light fixtures, ceiling medallions, floor to ceiling windows and original mantels. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,580 square feet. $314,900 Contact Jaimee A. Radloff with Roots Real Estate: Jaimee@rootsrealesta

item.title: Nice interior! Circa 1920. Over an acre in Arkansas. $185,000
item.description: This house has a nice interior! Big yard too! The house was built in 1920. It is located on 1.05 acres in Osceola, Arkansas. The house features a porte cochere, pretty wood floors, original windows, vintage light fixtures, baseboards, crown moulding, french doors, built-in china cabinet, spacious kitchen and a large sunroom. There is a detached garage and a detached storage shed on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 3,167 square feet. $185,000 Contact Rena Brown with 1st Choice Realt

item.title: So cute! Look inside! Circa 1937 in California. $259,000
item.description: This is so cute! Love the interior! Would make a great vacation spot! The house was built in 1937. It is located in Lake Arrowhead, California. The house features a large deck, vaulted ceiling, loft area, wood stove, exposed beams and baseboards. The home is close to local amenities, outdoor activities, dining and shopping. One bedroom, one bathroom and 472 square feet. $259,000 Contact Alyssa Wenz with Vista Sotheby’s: 951-684-1300 From the Zillow listing: Back on Market at No Fault to Seller!

item.title: Pretty stairs and stained glass! Circa 1889 in Colorado. $299,000
item.description: This house has a pretty staircase! The bottom is rather unique. Love the stained glass windows! The house was built in 1889. It is located on .28 acre in Trinidad, Colorado. The house features a wrought iron fence, covered front porch, wood floors, pretty staircase, stained glass windows, baseboards, vintage light fixtures, spacious kitchen, crown moulding and pocket doors. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,234 square feet. $299,000 Contact Gina Raye with Authentic Colorado Properties: 719-680

item.title: $179,900! Four acres in Connecticut. Apple trees and blueberry bushes! C. 1785.
item.description: There are 50-60 mature blueberry bushes on this property! 200 year old apple trees also. The listing says this house has foundation issues. At first glance, I’m not seeing anything glaringly obvious. Going to guess there is a basement and that is where it’s most noticeable. The house was built in 1785.
